concerns.text: Consider adding query parameter caching or memoization for recurring search phrases to maintain sub-100ms response targets under peak load.
Ensure facet counts query is indexed on (type, specialty) to avoid full table scans as the catalog grows beyond initial dataset.
Ensure tap targets and focus ring styling remain fully compliant across custom vendor WebKit mobile browsers.
Service worker registration lifecycle should handle silent cache invalidation on deployment updates.
Verify error boundary and retry timeouts when network is severed mid-stream.
Keep OpenAPI contract schema synchronized with backend Pydantic models via automated CI schema validation.
Ensure 422 schema errors provide detailed pointer references for nested facet parameters.
Floating point precision for FTE calculations should be documented or rounded explicitly to standard institutional decimal limits.
Dynamic gauge rendering should respect user prefers-reduced-motion preferences for high-contrast transitions.
Backup key derivation and HMAC authentication secrets should strictly load from environment variables and avoid default fallback secrets in staging.
Sanitization middleware should thoroughly cover Cyrillic regex edge-cases in patronymics and multipart Russian surnames.
DOCX generator layout should lock XML table column widths to strictly avoid wrapping in non-standard Word viewers.
Clipboard copy toast feedback timeout should be cleared on component destroy to avoid memory leaks.
